Module.Title: PF2E Affliction Forge: Alchemist's Cabinet
Module.LibraryDescription: Original alchemical poisons, laboratory diseases, and experimental afflictions with semantic Creature Forge tags.
Module.SyncFailed: Alchemist's Cabinet could not synchronize its library. See console.

blinding-lime.Name: Blinding Lime
blinding-lime.Description: A finely milled alkaline laboratory powder that irritates eyes and airways and is often scattered from breakable ampoules in the field.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 1d6 poison damage, Sickened 1, Dazzled.

numbtongue-tonic.Name: Numbtongue Tonic
numbtongue-tonic.Description: A bitter tonic that first numbs the tongue, then speech and clear thought. In small doses it was originally developed as an analgesic additive.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: Stupefied 2. You cannot speak.

copperbite-paste.Name: Copperbite Paste
copperbite-paste.Description: A green-sheened weapon paste whose metallic salts attack nerves and balance once they enter a wound.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 1d6 poison damage, Clumsy 1, Sickened 1.

sombercap-distillate.Name: Sombercap Distillate
sombercap-distillate.Description: A concentrated fungal extract that induces fatigue and mental sluggishness. The undiluted version is notorious among unscrupulous tavern mixers.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: Slowed 1, Stupefied 1.

emberglass-coating.Name: Emberglass Coating
emberglass-coating.Description: This transparent weapon coating crystallizes in a wound and releases sharply reactive heat there.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 1d6 fire damage, 1d4 persistent fire damage.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 fire damage, 1d4 persistent fire damage, Clumsy 1.

hushmist-ampoule.Name: Hushmist Ampoule
hushmist-ampoule.Description: When shattered, the ampoule releases a heavy gray mist that swells the throat and turns even a shout into a hoarse effort.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 1d6 poison damage, Sickened 1. You cannot speak.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 1d6 poison damage, Sickened 2. You cannot speak.

nerve-lacquer.Name: Nerve-Lacquer
nerve-lacquer.Description: A thin black lacquer for blades and missiles that rapidly destroys fine motor control and at high doses slows entire movement patterns.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 poison damage, Clumsy 2, Slowed 1.

verdigris-fever.Name: Verdigris Fever
verdigris-fever.Description: A chronic poisoning caused by poorly stabilized alchemical metal compounds. Workshops with aging stills can expose entire crews to it.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 poison damage, Sickened 2, Drained 1.

blackout-resin.Name: Blackout Resin
blackout-resin.Description: A sticky weapon poison that makes sensory processing and memory blur into brief black gaps.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 poison damage, Stupefied 2, Slowed 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 5 flat check.

mutagen-bloom.Name: Mutagen Bloom
mutagen-bloom.Description: A failed mutagen can persist as an iridescent film and trigger uncontrolled physical changes on contact.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 poison damage, Clumsy 2, Sickened 1.

ghostsalt-injection.Name: Ghostsalt Injection
ghostsalt-injection.Description: This injectable solution contains occult-treated salts that draw vital essence from the body while poisoning the flesh.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 poison damage, 1d6 spirit damage, Drained 1.

smokeserpent-compound.Name: Smokeserpent Compound
smokeserpent-compound.Description: With this weapon poison, alchemists imitate the rapid paralysis of exotic snake venoms without requiring a living source.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 poison damage, Clumsy 1, Slowed 1.

marrow-solvent.Name: Marrow Solvent
marrow-solvent.Description: A corrosive weapon toxin that keeps reacting after entering tissue, attacking muscle and the surface of bone.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 2d6 acid damage, 1d6 persistent acid damage.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 acid damage, 1d6 persistent acid damage, Enfeebled 1.

glasslung-culture.Name: Glasslung Culture
glasslung-culture.Description: A cultivated alchemical spore strain settles in the lungs like fine dust and makes healing the inflamed tissue increasingly difficult.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 poison damage, Sickened 2, Drained 1. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

clockwork-bile.Name: Clockwork Bile
clockwork-bile.Description: An electrically charged lubricant and etching mixture from automaton laboratories. It is as unfriendly to organic bodies as it is to poorly insulated constructs.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 electricity damage, Clumsy 2, Slowed 1.

bloodbreaker-serum.Name: Bloodbreaker Serum
bloodbreaker-serum.Description: This red weapon solution disrupts blood production, causing even small injuries to drain the body with unusual severity.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 poison damage, Drained 2.

prism-toxin.Name: Prism Toxin
prism-toxin.Description: An arcane-stabilized weapon poison whose shifting crystals release different elemental discharges with each reaction.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 3d6 poison damage, 1d6 fire damage, Clumsy 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 poison damage, 1d6 cold damage, Clumsy 2.

mimic-spore-suspension.Name: Mimic-Spore Suspension
mimic-spore-suspension.Description: This suspension forces cultivated spores into aggressive growth and makes infected tissue imitate foreign structures.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 poison damage, Sickened 2, Clumsy 1, Drained 1.

kingmaker-poison.Name: Kingmaker Poison
kingmaker-poison.Description: A discreet court poison for envenomed blades. It first weakens the muscles, then attacks vitality itself.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 poison damage, Enfeebled 2, Drained 1.

red-tide-reagent.Name: Red Tide Reagent
red-tide-reagent.Description: A blood-red reagent absorbed through skin or food that drives the circulatory system toward feverish collapse.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 poison damage, Sickened 2, Drained 1.

nullsilver-catalyst.Name: Nullsilver Catalyst
nullsilver-catalyst.Description: A weapon coating of silvered salts and arcane inhibitors that disrupts thought and concentration as reliably as nerves.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 4d6 mental damage, Stupefied 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 7 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 mental damage, Stupefied 2, Slowed 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 7 flat check.

marrowfire-plague.Name: Marrowfire Plague
marrowfire-plague.Description: A deliberately cultivated laboratory disease whose reaction generates heat in the marrow and hinders recovery of the damaged body.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 fire damage, Drained 2. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

black-mercury.Name: Black Mercury
black-mercury.Description: A forbidden heavy-metal mixture that spreads as black vapor or gleaming droplets and poisons body and mind alike.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 5d6 poison damage, Clumsy 2, Stupefied 2.

thought-eater-elixir.Name: Thought-Eater Elixir
thought-eater-elixir.Description: This occult elixir binds fragments of memory to an alchemical carrier, making complex thought increasingly difficult to reach.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 3d6 mental damage, Stupefied 2. Concentrate actions require a DC 7 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 mental damage, Stupefied 2, Slowed 1. You cannot speak. Concentrate actions require a DC 9 flat check.

fleshweaver-serum.Name: Fleshweaver Serum
fleshweaver-serum.Description: An experimental regenerative agent that does not heal injured tissue but instead grows new and increasingly incorrect structures.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 poison damage, Clumsy 2, Drained 1. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

dragonbone-distillate.Name: Dragonbone Distillate
dragonbone-distillate.Description: Distilled from rare mineralized dragon remains, this compound combines toxic salts with a violent thermal reaction.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 5d6 poison damage, 2d6 fire damage, Sickened 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 6d6 poison damage, 2d6 fire damage, Sickened 2.

voidglass-poison.Name: Voidglass Poison
voidglass-poison.Description: A weapon poison aged in black glass, combining ordinary toxins with occult void and making its victims difficult to restore.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 5d6 poison damage, 3d6 void damage, Drained 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 6d6 poison damage, 3d6 void damage, Drained 2. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

homunculus-rot.Name: Homunculus Rot
homunculus-rot.Description: A failed nutrient medium for artificial life can become an aggressive disease that attempts to rewrite flesh according to alchemical blueprints.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 5d6 poison damage, Sickened 2, Stupefied 2, Drained 1.

phoenixbane-reagent.Name: Phoenixbane Reagent
phoenixbane-reagent.Description: This rare weapon poison was designed to weaken regenerative fire creatures: cold reagents smother recovery while the toxin drains the body.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 6d6 poison damage, 3d6 cold damage, Slowed 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 7d6 poison damage, 3d6 cold damage, Slowed 1, Drained 1. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

green-crucible-fever.Name: Green Crucible Fever
green-crucible-fever.Description: A catastrophic laboratory infection of living acids and mutagenic residues. Advanced cases consume tissue faster than it can heal.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 6d6 acid damage, Sickened 2, Drained 2. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

philosophers-blight.Name: Philosopher's Blight
philosophers-blight.Description: An attempt to preserve insight alchemically instead created a disease that erodes speech, memory, and concentrated thought.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 5d6 mental damage, Stupefied 2. Concentrate actions require a DC 9 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 6d6 mental damage, Stupefied 3, Slowed 1. You cannot speak. Concentrate actions require a DC 11 flat check. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

apex-distillate.Name: Apex Distillate
apex-distillate.Description: The Apex Distillate is not one recipe but a name for a perfected laboratory killing agent: a virulent mixture that attacks body, vitality, and even magical healing at once.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 8d6 poison damage, Drained 2, Slowed 1. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 8d6 poison damage, 4d6 void damage, Drained 3, death effect. You cannot regain Hit Points. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.
